basic_info.description: Located in the heart of Midtown Terrace, 119 Knollview offers convenient access to Midtown Terrace playground, Clarendon and Rooftop schools, Twin Peaks, Mount Sutro trails, and public transportation and is just over the hill from Forest Hill Station, close to Irving Street & West Portal corridor shops, and Mollie Stones grocery. This fully detached home sits across from picturesque green space and features 3 bright, airy bedrooms and 1 bathroom on the main level. The living room, fireplace, and formal dining room provide beautiful views of the hills and ocean. Updated kitchen with greenhouse window, stainless steel appliances, and granite counters. Downstairs, you'll find a spacious sitting room and an additional bedroom with a full bath, ideal for guests or extended living space. This level offers French doors to the walk-out patio and garden area. Owned Solar Panels, a side-by-side garage, and ample storage make this home move-in and ready to go.
